original_document.title: Other WE Services | My WE App, WE Pay, Apple Pay & MNP | Telecom Egypt - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: Services available: - Apple Pay: Now Available For WE Customers. Make Recharge, Paying your Bill & renewing your Package Simple & Secure with Apple Pay. - My WE App: You can manage your mobile & home internet accounts, complete all your transactions online whenever you want and wherever you are. - WE Pay: WE Pay is a service provided by WE in cooperation with Banque Misr to enable its customers to control their various financial transactions. - Mobile Number Portability: Service allows you to change your mobile network to another one keeping same number. - Telegram Services: You can send any telegram by calling 124 or visiting one of telegraph offices in WE stores. - Donation: Now with WE you can donate anytime and anywhere through your mobile phone in an easy and secure way. - Tamween: Now you can activate the supply card from your mobile. - Park your Line: New service for postpaid customers.
